detaileddescription.para: Provides reproducible latency measurements for the rpc_grpc module hot paths identified in the rpc_grpc module roadmap (Phase 5 — Performance and Hardening).

sect2.title: Benchmark families
sect2.para: Measures the cost of casting RpcGrpcError values from int32_t.
Measures switch-based dispatch across all RpcGrpcError codes.
Measures in-process heap allocation for RpcServiceDescriptor; release gate for service registration / reload paths.
Amortised error-cast cost across 1 000 mixed codes; simulates a high-frequency gRPC error classification loop.

sect2.title: Hard release gates
sect2.para: All benchmarks use kCanonicalSeed = 42 for deterministic inputs.
